annotations.title: Windows Server and SQL Server end-of-support dates

description: Call this when a user asks whether their website is at risk because its Windows Server or SQL Server version is out of support, for example Windows Server 2012 end of life. Returns Microsoft's end-of-support dates with a source link for each, plus the Extended Security Updates cutoff.
name: get_eol_facts
title: Windows Server and SQL Server end-of-support dates
